quote: On April 8, 2020, Riot Blockchain, Inc. ("Riot" or the "Corporation") entered into the Coinmint Co-Locating Mining Services Agreement (the "Coinmint Agreement") with Coinmint, LLC ("Coinmint"), for up to approximately 9,500 kilowatt hours of energy to power up to 4,000 new Antminer S-17 Pro miners (the "Miners").
